abstract_sentences.text: Human vision combines low-resolution “gist” information from the visual periphery with sparse but high-resolution information from fixated locations to construct a coherent understanding of a visual scene.

evidence.anchor: low-resolution “gist” information from the visual periphery

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we introduce MetamerGen, a tool for generating scenes that are aligned with latent human scene representations.

evidence.anchor: we introduce MetamerGen

abstract_sentences.text: MetamerGen is a latent diffusion model that combines peripherally obtained scene gist information with information obtained from scene-viewing fixations to generate image metamers for what humans understand after viewing a scene.

evidence.anchor: combines peripherally obtained scene gist information

abstract_sentences.text: Generating images from both high and low resolution (i.e. “foveated”) inputs constitutes a novel image-to-image synthesis problem, which we tackle by introducing a dual-stream representation of the foveated scenes consisting of DINOv2 tokens that fuse detailed features from fixated areas with peripherally degraded features capturing scene context.

evidence.anchor: novel image-to-image synthesis problem

abstract_sentences.text: To evaluate the perceptual alignment of MetamerGen generated images to latent human scene representations, we conducted a same-different behavioral experiment where participants were asked for a “same” or “different” response between the generated and the original image.

evidence.anchor: conducted a same-different behavioral experiment

abstract_sentences.text: With that, we identify scene generations that are indeed metamers for the latent scene representations formed by the viewers.

evidence.anchor: scene generations that are indeed metamers

abstract_sentences.text: MetamerGen is a powerful tool for understanding scene understanding.

evidence.anchor: a powerful tool for understanding scene understanding

abstract_sentences.text: Our proof-of-concept analyses uncovered specific features at multiple levels of visual processing that contributed to human judgments.

evidence.anchor: features at multiple levels of visual processing

abstract_sentences.text: While it can generate metamers even conditioned on random fixations, we find that high-level semantic alignment most strongly predicts metamerism when the generated scenes are conditioned on viewers’ own fixated regions.

evidence.anchor: high-level semantic alignment most strongly predicts metamerism

experimental_design.name: research_question

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以 same-different metamer judgment 操作化 latent human scene understanding，用 DINOv2 dual-stream 将 peripheral gist 与 sparse fixation 送入 latent diffusion，再以层级 feature analysis 和 stream ablation 解释判断来源（p.2、p.4、p.6、p.9–10）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留架构、Eq. (3)–(5)、训练/推理关键 knobs、COCO/Visual Genome separation、own/random behavioral design、29.4%/27.7% rate、multi-level feature 方向和 54.5%/45.8%/8.4% stream rates（p.5–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: A.1–A.10 承担 eye-tracking 与硬件、Perceiver 细节、逐变量 regression、object metrics、PSNR、完整 stream correlations、DINOv2/CLIP 对照和全部生成样例（p.16–26）；semantic superiority 与复现核查依赖这些页。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 同一 behavioral criterion 同时承担生成效能和机制检验；Fig.4/5 以 low/mid/high hierarchy 排列 proxies，Fig.13/14 再用 stream deletion 对齐行为率，形成 generation → judgment → mechanism → ablation 链（p.8–9、p.23–24）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: feature analysis 是 post-hoc correlation/stepwise regression，主模型 R²=0.039，分母、error-bar 和检验细节未完整报告；own/random rate 无显著差异却被延伸为减少 eye-data collection 的 practical implication，且 faces/limbs/text 被排除（p.7–10、p.17）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 主张生成结果对齐 latent human representation 时，应在正文让同一 human decision criterion 同时承担效能判定和机制检验，并将每个 representation level 映射到 matched feature contrast 或 component ablation（p.6–10）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合有明确 behavioral equivalence criterion、可实时生成且可建立多层 representation proxies 的视觉生成研究；对含大量未建模元素或缺少短时 same/different criterion 的任务，不应直接外推 latent alignment（p.6、p.10）。

statistical_summary.aggregation_unit: same/different behavioral responses summarized as proportion “same”; exact denominator and participant/trial aggregation are not specified.
statistical_summary.primary_comparison: own fixation 29.4% vs random fixation 27.7%, p=0.24; test name not specified.
statistical_summary.feature_models: forward stepwise linear regression with 8 variables; primary R²=0.039 and random-fixation R²=0.031 in A.4.
statistical_summary.association_panels: Figures 4, 5 and 14 use feature-similarity curves; Figure 14 prints r and p values.
statistical_summary.uncertainty_reporting: Error bars appear in several figures, but their estimator is not defined; no conventional confidence interval is claimed in this reading.
statistical_summary.multiplicity_and_validation: Multiple-comparison correction, preregistration, seed aggregation, cross-validation and independent holdout are not reported.
